metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.1 · 1991 · The Crumbs
metas.description: Tween Mads is having trouble fitting in: he's got a crush on a female classmate--and his clumsy father is a teacher at his school. By an unforeseen chance of events, Mads becomes somewhat of a hero, but will he win the girl?

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.6 · 1992 · Crumb at a Gallop
metas.description: Everything is normal with the Krumborg family, Two robbers want to kidnap Krumme all the while Krumme's present accidentally winds up with Mrs.Olsen.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.8 · 1994 · The Crumbs 3: Dad's Bright Idea
metas.description: The Krunborg family has new problems: a freshly painted house that won't dry, a tent with holes and a car that won't go anywhere and much much more.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.4 · 2006 · The Crumbs: A Very Crumby Christmas
metas.description: Krumme argues with his whole class about whether Santa Claus exists. Up at Santa's house, the magic book has disappeared, and that means the end of Christmas. So now Krumme has to prove that Santa Claus exists and save Christmas. But the robbers Boris and Ivan are also on the hunt for Santa's book. All in all, a perfectly normal Christmas at the Krummer family's house.
